name: Into Your Heart: Revamped
source:
Into Your Heart is a visual novel with dating sim elements and a slow burn narrative, where you play as a young man navigating his everyday life, forming bonds, breaking others, and questioning everything in between.

The story explores the freedom of the mind and the weight of morality in a world unraveling into chaos.

[From F95Zone]
